meta.title: Mayfly24 — People. AI. Real Impact.
meta.description: Mayfly24 connects people, practical AI knowledge and professional collaboration to build stronger communities and create meaningful opportunities.

hero.supportingCopy: We bring people, knowledge and technology together to create meaningful solutions, stronger professional communities and lasting value.

about.headline: More than technology.
about.intro: Mayfly24 brings together people who believe that technology is most valuable when it creates meaningful opportunities. We connect professionals, share practical knowledge and build a culture where trust, quality and continuous development come first.

highlights.title: Meaningful human connections
highlights.description: An education- and community-driven organisation built on genuine professional relationships, not just technology.

highlights.title: Practical technological knowledge
highlights.description: A strong focus on artificial intelligence, shared through practical education and honest, hands-on knowledge sharing.

highlights.title: Transparent professional collaboration
highlights.description: An evolving framework connecting independent professionals around clear communication and realistic commitments.

pillars.title: Education and community
pillars.description: We make AI and emerging technologies more accessible through practical education, knowledge sharing and genuine professional relationships.

pillars.title: Business and collaboration
pillars.description: We are building a transparent framework where independent professionals and organisations can connect, collaborate and turn their knowledge into meaningful projects.

community.headline: Better together.
community.intro: Mayfly24 is not only about technology or business. It is about creating an environment where professionals can belong, learn and grow together.

collaboration.headline: Real knowledge. Real collaboration. Real impact.
collaboration.supportingCopy: We believe meaningful innovation starts with understanding the challenge, bringing the right people together and working towards a shared goal.
principles: Understanding real problems before proposing solutions

values.title: Trust

values.title: Precision

values.title: Professional excellence

values.title: Continuous development

values.title: Mutual respect
